column3: Roadmap grounding packet 01: Ground a roadmap statement against already-implemented evidence and identify the smallest bounded follow-up packet.
Docs index packet 01: Check docs/report index consistency for the supervised worker and prompt-patch evidence chain without changing tracked files.
Artifact validation packet 01: Validate a dogfood artifact condition, preserving any failure evidence and describing the deterministic check only.
Prompt patch fixture review packet 01: Review a prompt patch fixture candidate or pack for structural soundness without importing it into tracked fixtures.
Candidate export rehearsal packet 01: Rehearse candidate export from a supervised live run or candidate draft path while keeping the export review-only.
Authority boundary wording packet 01: Audit wording that defines evidence-only behavior, no auto-promotion, and no authority expansion.
Evidence retention packet 01: Preserve failures, diagnostics, and rejected artifacts without normalizing them away.
Queue/state consistency packet 01: Check queue and state alignment for a supervised dogfood batch without repair.
Closeout skeleton packet 01: Draft a closeout skeleton for a completed supervised evidence loop using only local evidence paths and status fields.
Failure preservation packet 01: Record how a failure case should remain as evidence instead of being normalized or removed from the batch trail.
Evidence packet sanity packet 01: Inspect whether a bounded evidence packet has the minimum fields needed for later validation and review.
Review bundle completeness packet 01: Verify that a review bundle contains the expected hashes, authority boundaries, and result summaries for human review.
